top_signals.title: US Yield Swings Abate Before Jobs Data After Volatile Week
top_signals.summary: US Treasuries posted small moves at the end of a volatile week as bondholders awaited a key jobs report for clues on the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate path.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Sirius XM’s Newest Bull Sees 50% Upside on YouTube, Amazon Pacts
top_signals.summary: Underappreciated partnerships with a pair of tech megacaps could mean Sirius XM Holdings Inc. shares are poised to extend a significant gain this year, according to Deutsche Bank, which upgraded the stock to buy from hold this week.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
